[color=#00ff00]这是一个相对规整的农场。
地图下方有很多土地可以种植，实际上所有图块都可以种植作物，根据你的喜好规划。
默认替换标准农场。
农场中可以钓到海鱼和湖鱼
This is a tidy farm.
There are many lands below the map that can be planted, and in fact, all the paths can be planted with crops. Plan according to your hobbies.
Default replacement of standard farm.
You can catch beach and mountain fish on the farm.[/color]
